scientificObservations: In the six-membered sigma-complex the attacked carbon has two ring bonds, one neutral E substituent and one H: four single bonds.
Exactly two remaining double bonds and one ring carbocation symbol show a valid resonance contributor, not an extra attached charged electrophile.
Final ring restores the aromatic circle and keeps one neutral E; H is separate H+ and total charge is conserved.
This conceptual reaction scheme supports aromatic reactivity. It does not purport to prove all resonance contributors, kinetics, or a specific reagent/catalyst system.

observations: Reaction direction, ring outlines, two double bonds, E/H and the positive charge remain distinguishable.
Labels and the friendly schematic motif remain recognisable at actual 360px; no fine apparatus details or large paragraphs.
All comparison labels and relevant chemical details remain clear at the actual 680px rendering.

scientificObservations: Columns name actual Ethanal and Propanon rather than claiming universal aldehyde/ketone discrimination.
Ethanal has an illustrated silver mirror in Tollens and a red Cu2O precipitate in Fehling; Propanon has no silver mirror and retains blue Fehling solution.
The prominent Nur diese Beispiele limits the scope. An alpha-hydroxyketone counterexample is not silently excluded from the chemistry of all ketones.
The picture illustrates test interpretation, not a record of an actually performed supervised experiment.

observations: Row/column layout, both named examples, mirror, red solid and retained blue solution remain distinguishable.
Cu2O label is the smallest detail; the red solid and row context carry the main comparison. This small formula is not the sole carrier of a required distinction.
All comparison labels and relevant chemical details remain clear at the actual 680px rendering.
